errors.error_description: The next-state logic in an always_comb block omits assigning next_state on some paths (state S_PREP when ext_pause is true), inferring a level-sensitive latch within a combinational block.
A deeply nested chain of if-else constructs is used to compute 'throttle', creating long combinational paths that are suboptimal for synthesis.
A signal 'debug_shadow' is declared but never driven or used anywhere, resulting in an unused signal.
